title: FIDLOCK’s Latest Bright Idea: The New PINCLIP Interchangeable Magnetic Light System
content:
Always expanding its line of tool-free mounted accessories, FIDLOCK has now introduced lights to its magnetic-mechanically fastened ecosystem. Their new PINCLIP front and rear lights offer quick, easy-to-install illumination with mounts that can also accommodate other FIDLOCK accessories.

The PINCLIP front light is not a high-powered unit for night riding on MTB trails, but the set is ideal for commuting, evening road rides, or pedalling around town in the dark. When you’re not using the front light, the mount can carry a POV camera instead. The rear light can be swapped out for FIDLOCK’s PINCLIP saddle bag, or installed on your seat post.

PINCLIP Mounts:

FIDLOCK’S PINCLIP mounts provide a magnetic-mechanical fastening system. Magnets help guide the lights into the mounts, then the light securely snaps into position. The lights can be easily released from the mount with one hand. PINCLIP mounts offer a strong connection with no rattles, and can handle rough off-road terrain. Switching between accessories requires no tools.

If the front light is not needed, you can swap it for a POV camera and capture your ride. You’ll just need to add a PINCLIP Action Cam Mount (not included in the kit). The Action Cam Mount offers a GoPro-style interface for the camera itself, and it attaches your camera to the front light’s handlebar mount.

The rear light can be mounted directly to a seat tube. However, if you choose to use the saddle base to mount your rear light, you can also snap a PINCLIP seat bag into the mount when the light is not needed.

“At FIDLOCK, we’re always looking for ways to make everyday interactions with equipment simpler,” said Andreas Schulz, Marketing Director. “The PINCLIP Light System is more than just another set of bike lights. It’s about giving riders the flexibility to switch between lighting, an action camera, or a saddle bag quickly and securely, using the same mounting system.”

PINCLIP Front Light:

The new PINCLIP front light provides a 100 lumen/50 Lux output via a single OSRAM LED bulb, offering visibility up to 200m. The light is weatherproof and shock-resistant, and measures 43 x 52 x 108 mm.

The front light features High/Medium/Low settings. Run times are 5 hours (high), 12 hours (medium), or 22 hours (low). A battery level indicator on the light shows how much power you have left.

The front light is powered by a rechargeable Li-ion 2600 mAh battery, which charges via USB-C. A full charge takes five hours. The battery is also replaceable, due to incoming regulations in Europe.

The front light mount is secured to your handlebar with a ratchet strap and a dial to snug it up. The reversible PINCLIP interface gives you the option of running the light above or below your handlebar. This offers versatility for different handlebar setups, or bars already crowded with add-ons. The handlebar mount fits bars with diameters from 22.2-40 mm.

PINCLIP Rear Light:

FIDLOCK’s PINCLIP rear light uses three LEDs to output 4cd (candelas) in steady mode, but brightens to 16cd when it’s acting as a brake light. This light operates in a steady mode unless its acceleration sensor activates the brake light function. Dimensions for the rear light are 38x38x33mm, and it is both weatherproof and shock resistant.

The rear light includes a rechargeable 300 mAh battery, which provides five hours of run time. The battery charges in two hours via USB-C. The light has a battery level indicator, so you know when you’re getting low.  

This light either mounts directly to a seat tube or snaps into a PINCLIP saddle base. The seat tube mount is secured with a ratchet strap, which fits post diameters from 22-38.6mm. The PINCLIP saddle base bolts onto the rear part of your seat rails.

Pricing/Availability:

The PINCLIP Light System will initially be available as a complete set only, including the front light, rear light, mounting bases, a saddle base adapter, and a USB-C charging cable. MSRP for the kit is $99.99 (at the time of publication, the set is currently on sale for $79.99).

The system will be available in the USA around the end of November. FIDLOCK plans to offer the front and rear lights individually in the future.
